final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT orderslink AS order_reference, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS group_average, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.group_average, s1.record_count, s1.group_average - s2.overall_average AS difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.group_average > s2.overall_average) SELECT AVG(group_average), AVG(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
